remarks: This fantastic and spacious two-bedroom, two-bath condominium is perfectly located in the heart of downtown Stamford. The large gourmet kitchen with center island opens to a fabulous, light-filled living area. An ideal split-bedroom floorplan ensures privacy, with bedrooms and baths thoughtfully separated. Transom windows above the sliders in the living room and primary suite are a beautiful architectural flourish. Step onto your balcony overlooking the beautifully landscaped courtyard for a serene retreat. Enjoy building perks including a fully equipped fitness center, a stylish meeting room for work or gatherings, dry-cleaning service and attentive concierge.  Just steps from Stamford's vibrant dining, shopping, theaters, waterfront parks, and Metro-North station-this condo delivers effortless city living with comfort, convenience, and style.
